name: HD Fire Protect
summary: India's #2 fire-protection equipment maker and largest exporter (sprinklers, deluge valves, foam systems), with the most UL/FM certifications among Indian peers.
financials: FY26 revenue ₹489 Cr (+13%), PAT ₹117 Cr, EBITDA margin 31%, debt-free
positives: Certification moat and 30% RoE; priced at 40.7x vs peer average 63x
Strong anchor book: ₹213 Cr, 72% to HDFC/ICICI Pru/Kotak/ABSL MFs
red_flags: 100% OFS — promoters selling, company gets nothing
₹196 Cr dividends to promoters in the last two years
PAT growth slowed to 6% in FY26; inventory days rising
anchor: ₹213 Cr from 25 anchors: HDFC MF, ICICI Pru, Kotak, ABSL MF, Mirae, UTI, Allianz
